content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 reflects missing required authorization; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, and the valid coding and correct billing order provide no basis for correction. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available because a denial is on the table and remains an untried payer remedy after submission with records failed. The deductible alone does not establish patient liability for this authorization denial, so billing the patient or writing off the balance would be premature.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
